description: Describe one table in a base, returning its fields and views at the requested level of detail.

baseId.description: ID of the Airtable base containing the table to describe.

detailLevel.description: Level of detail for the returned table: tableIdentifiersOnly (table ID and name only), identifiersOnly (IDs and names for tables, fields, and views), or full (the complete schema, the default).

tableId.description: ID or name of the table to describe.

name: describe_table
